mass_inertia_policy: Core scene for the next version: the worktable keeps its canonical mass/inertia and is bolted to the driven platen, so the six-axis compliant isolation stage is removed while the tabletop drive, contacts and under-table IMU are unchanged. Panda and solid shore foundation belong to world; no compensating ballast.
reference: Same room, solid foundation, deck footprint and task layout as world_fixed_arm_v1; the only physical difference is the rigid worktable mount. Worktable is inset 0.06 m from the shore-facing deck edge.
